title: Land Use, Conservation, Traffic Project Talks
summary:
*   **Major Environmental & Conservation:** Council discussed legal strategies for the "Tank Farm Case" lawsuit against Mobil Oil and land acquisition for the Balcones Canyonland Conservation Plan (BCCP).
*   **Key Infrastructure Development:** Deliberations included acquiring property for the Oltorf at South Congress Avenue Traffic System Management Project to improve traffic flow.
*   **Local Zoning Review:** Private discussion was held regarding a specific zoning case for property at 336 East Ben White Blvd.
